title: 第1章 师妹林清瑶第2章 于步履之间感悟天地
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
【主角就是个凡人，不能修炼，彻头彻尾的凡人。
【前期主角的领域增加会慢，但随着系统的解锁等阶会越来越快。
修仙界，东荒域。
天衍宗。
群峰耸立，流云环绕。
主殿金顶映着晨光，七峰依次排开，剑气如虹，仙鹤盘旋。
此刻，宗门主殿前的平台之上。
陆鸣正扶着一棵松树眺望远方山峦。
他穿着一身亲传弟子服饰，眉目如墨画，肤白似玉琢。
晨光落在他身上，仿佛为他镀上了一层柔光。
引得过往弟子窃窃私语。
“这位师兄是谁？好帅！”
“从未见过，到底是哪一峰的亲传师兄？竟有如此风采？”
“这位师兄为何站在此处做什么？”
“嘘，小点声，这位师兄可是亲传弟子，你且看他浑身灵气毫不外泄，修为不知道高到哪里去了，这位师兄能站在此处定是在悟道！”
“悟道？”
年轻弟子立马噤声，生怕打扰了陆鸣悟道。
然而，背对众人的陆鸣，此刻却气喘吁吁，额角甚至还带着沁出的细汗。
几缕墨发微湿，狼狈的贴在颊边。
听到周围的耳语声，陆鸣抽了抽嘴角。

悟道？
悟个锤子的道！
我之所以扶着松树站在这里，纯粹是因为我没有修为是个凡人啊！
你们这些修士动辄御剑，而我要想来此地，就得实打实的爬山啊！
特么的，可累死老子了。
三年前，陆鸣身穿到这个玄幻世界。
本以为自己能和小说中的主角一样，出门遇美女，随处碰机缘。
可事与愿违。
陆鸣不是这个世界的人，所以根本就不能像这世界的人一样修炼。
三年前刚穿越过来，他就被一头野猪追赶。
慌不择路下，一头撞在树上差点死掉。
好在，她的师尊苏寒仪偶然出现救下了他，
见他孤身一人还无半点修为，所以便收他做了弟子。
当然，苏寒仪能收他为徒主要是因为他长得足够帅。
这可并非陆鸣自夸，这句话可是苏寒仪亲口承认的。
content_en:
[The protagonist is a mortal, unable to practice, a complete mortal.
[The protagonist's domain will increase slowly in the early stage, but it will become faster and faster as the system unlocks levels.
Cultivation world, Eastern Wasteland.
Tian Yan Sect.
The peaks stand tall and are surrounded by flowing clouds.
The golden dome of the main hall reflects the morning light, with seven peaks arranged in sequence, sword energy like a rainbow, and cranes circling.
At this moment, on the platform in front of the main hall of the sect.
Lu Ming was holding a pine tree and looking at the mountains in the distance.
He was wearing the clothes of a direct disciple, his eyebrows were like ink paintings, and his skin was as white as jade.
The morning light fell on him, as if giving him a soft light.
It caused the passing disciples to whisper.
"Who is this senior brother? So handsome!"
"I have never seen him, which peak's direct senior brother is he? He is so elegant?"
"Why is this senior brother standing here and doing what?"
"Shhh, keep your voice down. This senior brother is his direct disciple. Look at him, his spiritual energy is not leaking out. I don't know how high his cultivation level is. If this senior brother can stand here, he must be enlightening!"
"Enlightenment?"
The young disciple immediately kept silent, for fear of disturbing Lu Ming's enlightenment.
However, Lu Ming, who had his back to everyone, was panting at the moment, and there was even a trickle of sweat on his forehead.
A few strands of black hair were slightly damp and clinging to his cheeks awkwardly.
Hearing the whispers around him, Lu Ming twitched the corner of his mouth.
Enlightenment?
Understand the way of hammer!
The reason why I stand here holding on to the pine tree is purely because I am a mortal without cultivation!
You monks wield swords at every turn, but if I want to come here, I have to actually climb the mountain!
Damn it, I’m so exhausted.
Three years ago, Lu Ming entered this fantasy world.
I thought I could be like the protagonist in the novel, meeting beautiful women when going out and taking chances everywhere.
But things went counterproductive.
Lu Ming is not from this world, so he cannot practice like people from this world.
Just after crossing over three years ago, he was chased by a wild boar.
In a panic, he hit his head against a tree and almost died.
Fortunately, her master Su Hanyi accidentally appeared and saved him.
Seeing that he was alone and without any cultivation, he accepted him as his disciple.
Of course, Su Hanyi could accept him as her disciple mainly because he was handsome enough.
This is not Lu Ming's boast, Su Hanyi admitted it personally.
